verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk-operation capability, such as selecting many items, records, or elements and applying one action to all of them. Running several chats at once, attaching multiple designs as context, editing records one by one in the admin panel, and packaging workflows as reusable instructions are adjacent features, not bulk operations. Bulk actions are a fair axis for an AI app builder, so the absence of evidence is none, not na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
